missing_evidence: Redis server latency/error metrics for the incident window
Inventory service logs confirming Redis connection state
candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in the inventory service, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, which propagates as ReadTimeout to order and 502 at gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of the Redis timeout (load, saturation, network) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s; metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
